title: Four lemma (surjectivity) in an abelian category
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and consider a commutative diagram in $\mathcal A$

$$
\begin{array}{ccccccc}
W&\to&X&\to&Y&\to&Z\\
\downarrow{\scriptstyle\alpha}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle\beta}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle\gamma}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle\delta}\\
W'&\to&X'&\to&Y'&\to&Z'
\end{array}
$$

whose rows are exact at $X,Y$ and at $X',Y'$. If $\alpha$ and $\gamma$ are epimorphisms and $\delta$ is a monomorphism, then $\beta$ is an epimorphism.
